text:
I've written the review skill and a question list for each of the four design systems. They're committed as `ca31ba0f` on `worktree/review`, and I've closed my own task log (not the parent's).

**What I wrote**
- **The review skill** (`.claude/skills/review/SKILL.md`, 77 lines) covers:
  - **Who the reviewer is:** fresh eyes, never the author.
  - **What it loads:** the page, layout, css and content skills, plus all four question lists.
  - **What it's given:** the task's `shots/` folder: four widths per page, a contact sheet and `layout.json`.
  - **The order:** requirements first, then page structure, navigation (identify the techniques first), layout, sizing, wrapping, spacing and padding, colour and contrast, flow, and finally words.
  - **How to read a shot:** in horizontal bands, top to bottom.
  - **How to answer:** one line per question.
  - **The report:** saved as `review/report.md`.
- **The question lists**, one `questions.md` beside each skill:

| File | Questions | Sections |
|---|---|---|
| `page/questions.md` | 22 | page structure 1–12, navigation 13–22 (13 is "identify the techniques") |
| `layout/questions.md` | 30 | layout 1–12, sizing 13–19, wrapping 20–24, flow 25–30 |
| `css/questions.md` | 18 | spacing and padding 1–10, colour and contrast 11–18 |
| `content/questions.md` | 11 | words |

- **Pointer lines:** each of the four `SKILL.md` files got one new line pointing at its question list, and nothing else changed there.

**Three things differ from the brief**
- **Numbering:** questions are numbered straight through each file, not restarting per section. That keeps a citation like `layout 4` pointing at one question.
- **Measured questions:** these cite `layout.json`, the file `layout-check.mjs --bands` actually writes. You sent the same correction while I was working, so nothing changed after it.
- **Report file name:** `Server/review.mjs` still writes `<taskdir>/review.md`, but the skill says `review/report.md`, as the brief asks. That script is outside my fence, so whoever owns it needs to change the path. I checked that the skill's example report parses correctly with the script's own parser.

**Rules with no written source.** These questions come from your words today and are marked `[owner 2026-09-30]`:
- the tab-row limits (page 14)
- grouping many tabs (page 16)
- the sheet, modal and full-screen checks (page 20, 21)
- band share of the screen (layout 7)
- unexpected wraps (layout 20, 21)
- stacked left padding over 3em (css 1, 2)
- paragraphs of 60 words or fewer (content 3)
- a picture beside a file of words (content 9)

The page that shows every question live, `/framework/ai/review/`, is the other minion's job and isn't built yet.

Fixed and committed as `3f14c08a`: each step in "The order" now names its section instead of a number range, Navigation says its first question is identify, and the report example still uses cites like `page 14`.

Task landed. One-line report:

**Review questions page now fills the width.** `/framework/ai/review/` — empty space at 1920 dropped from 74% to 49.2%, and at 3440 from 83% to 54.1%, by putting the 9 system sections into the page's `wide` track with `.masonry` (zero-JS CSS columns) and wrapping each system in a `card pad flow` box. No new CSS. Committed as `public/framework/ai/review/page.js` only; before/after sheet at `/framework/ai/2026-09-30/review/page-wide/shots/localhost-64869-framework-ai-review/sheet.png`.

Both deliverables are done, committed separately on `worktree/review`:

1. `10de086b` — `Server/review.mjs --questions` now resolves its own tree from `import.meta.url` (never the shared main tree via `--git-common-dir`), and skips writing `questions.json` when nothing changed except the timestamp.
2. `9562fda3` — `Server/merge.mjs`'s review gate now refuses a branch that touches a page but whose review has no `review/report.md`; it reuses `review.mjs`'s `pageUrlFor` instead of keeping its own copy. Header comment and `Server/doc/review.md` updated to match.

All six fixes from the [fresh-eyes review](/framework/ai/2026-09-30/review/review/) are answered and committed (`af71a912`) in the worktree, following the brief exactly through "commit, reply one line per fix, stop":

1. **Card shows the report** — `Server/review.mjs` now posts a `card_reply` (verdict, finding count, report and shots URLs) to the task's card right after every `{"review":…}` line lands.
2. **Wall reads in order** — [`/framework/ai/review/`](/framework/ai/review/)'s wall swaps `.masonry` for `.grid.auto gap`, which is row-major, so the systems now read left-to-right in `questions.json`'s own order (proven in the shot: Page structure → Navigation → Layout at 1920, five systems in a row at 3440).
3. **Tiles band** — the concept tiles moved into the page's `wide` track, so all nine fit on one row at 1920 and 3440 instead of wrapping to three.
4. **"What's in flight"** — moved to right after the tiles, before the wall.
5. **Readme count** — explains Requirements questions live in the review skill's own text (no `questions.md`), and removes the now-confirmed-unused `SYSTEM_ICON.Requirements` entry.
6. **Gate wording** — `Server/merge.mjs`'s refusal (and header comment) no longer claims to check shots at four widths; it only checks that `review/report.md` exists.

Checked: `node --check` clean on all four touched files; `layout-check.mjs --bands` against the live worktree server shows zero errors and zero big-empty bands at every width. Details and the reasoning behind each fix are logged in [`task.jsonl`](/framework/ai2/2026/09/30/review/fixes/).
